description: Engine §9.3 rejects an unreachable `.followed-by` terminal target that no body or nested query builds.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P @(A)
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions ¬$.followed-by(T)
%rule unit A
%rule family unit
%rule want A
